note: The 'spirit' sense the three sentences need ('Evil spirits lived in the old house') is already an accepted alt, so nothing is missing.
Three of the four sentences need 'fever' («У ребёнка си́льный жар.» = 'The child has a high fever.'), a sense only mentioned in the parenthetical and never graded.
Every sentence renders зада́ча as 'task', and the 'problem' sense the flag worries about is already an accepted alt.
«Заня́тия нача́лись в де́вять.» = 'Classes started at nine' and «Она́ опозда́ла на заня́тие.» = 'late for the class' need the taught-session sense, which 'activity' does not reach.
All three sentences render заявле́ние as 'statement', and the formal-written-request sense of «заявле́ние об увольне́нии» is already covered by the existing alt 'application'.

alt: fulfilment (the carrying out of a promise or duty)
note: «Мы ждём исполне́ния обеща́ния.» = 'We are waiting for the fulfilment of the promise', and 'performance' is not an English word for that.
The two narrative sentences ('funny stories', 'scary stories') are covered by the existing alt 'story'.

alt: classroom (a subject room at a school)
note: «В шко́ле мно́го све́тлых кабине́тов.» = 'There are many bright classrooms at the school', a school sense that 'office' does not reach.
«Я плачу́ ка́ртой.» needs 'card', which is already an accepted alt.
All three sentences render кла́ссика as 'classical music', which is the standard gloss itself; nothing is uncovered.
«Пти́ца сиди́т в кле́тке.» needs 'cage', which is already an accepted alt alongside 'cell'.
All three sentences render ко́йка as 'bunk' — no sentence actually needs 'bed', and adding it would loosen grading against «крова́ть».
The 'make-up' rendering used by all three sentences is already an accepted alt.
'cardigan', the rendering in all four sentences, is already an accepted alt.
«На стро́йке рабо́тают высо́кие кра́ны.» needs 'crane', which is already an accepted alt.
«Бегу́н сде́лал не́сколько круго́в.» = 'The runner did several laps', a sense 'circle (a round shape)' does not reach.
All three sentences need 'club' («Сын хо́дит в кружо́к рисова́ния.» = 'goes to a drawing club'), while only the ungraded parenthetical hints at it.
Every sentence renders кры́шка as 'lid'; the flag concerns «я́щик» in the third sentence, not this headword's gloss.
The sentences use 'hen'/'hens' and the flag concerns «обе́д», not the gloss, which already carries 'chicken' as an alt.

alt: exchange rate (the value of one currency against another)
note: «Курс до́ллара сего́дня вы́рос.» = 'The dollar exchange rate rose today', a sense named only in the ungraded parenthetical.
All three sentences are paper — «Он вы́рвал листо́к из тетра́ди.» = 'He tore a sheet out of the exercise book' — and 'leaf' never grades that (the sibling «лист=leaf» already carries a 'sheet' alt).
«Поли́ция устана́вливает ли́чность челове́ка.» = 'establishing the person's identity', which 'personality' does not cover.
«Он люби́тель ста́рых фи́льмов.» = 'a lover of old films' and «для люби́телей джа́за» = 'for jazz lovers' need the enthusiast sense, which 'amateur' does not carry.

alt: manhole (a covered opening in a road)
note: «Маши́на прова́лилась в откры́тый люк.» = 'The car fell into an open manhole' — a car cannot fall into a 'hatch'.
«Не волну́йся и́з-за тако́й ме́лочи.» = 'Don't worry about such a trifle', a sense only the ungraded parenthetical mentions.
«Он сде́лал недово́льную ми́ну.» needs the facial sense, already covered by the existing alt 'expression'.
«Гла́вный ми́нус э́той рабо́ты — ни́зкая зарпла́та.» = 'The main drawback of this job', a sense named only in the ungraded parenthetical.
«Все наро́ды хотя́т ми́ра.» needs 'peace', which is already an accepted alt.
«Прове́рьте нали́чие това́ра.» = 'Check the availability of the goods' and «зави́сит от нали́чия вре́мени» both need 'availability', absent from the gloss.

alt: referral (a doctor's note sending a patient on)
note: «Врач дал мне направле́ние к специали́сту.» = 'gave me a referral to a specialist', which 'direction' does not cover.
«Весь наро́д вы́шел на у́лицы.» needs 'nation', which is already an accepted alt.
«Мы страда́ем от недоста́тка воды́.» = 'We suffer from a shortage of water', a sense only the ungraded parenthetical mentions.

alt: hotel room (a room let out to a guest)
note: «В гости́нице нет свобо́дных номеро́в.» = 'There are no free rooms at the hotel' — the hotel sense is named only in the ungraded parenthetical; 'hotel room' rather than bare 'room' keeps it clear of «ко́мната».
«в о́бласти медици́ны» needs 'field', which is already an accepted alt.

alt: atmosphere (the feel of a place or occasion)
note: Two sentences need it — «Мы рабо́таем в дру́жеской обстано́вке.» = 'in a friendly atmosphere' and «Он лю́бит дома́шнюю обстано́вку.» = 'a homely atmosphere' — and neither 'situation' nor 'furnishings' reaches that.
«Учени́к провёл интере́сный о́пыт.» = 'The pupil carried out an interesting experiment', a sense named only in the ungraded parenthetical.

alt: tool (an implement regarded as a means of doing something)
note: «Кисть — гла́вное оруди́е худо́жника.» = 'the artist's main tool' and «рабо́тали просты́ми оруди́ями» = 'simple tools' both need it, and 'weapon' does not reach it.
«Де́ти игра́ют на переме́не.» needs the school break sense, already covered by the existing alt 'break (school)'.
'jacket', the rendering the flagged sentence uses, is already an accepted alt.
All three sentences render пирожо́к as 'pie', the standard gloss itself, and 'pasty' is already an alt.
